stemMd: All machines approved for overnight operation have an automatic shutoff. Machine Cobalt lacks an automatic shutoff. Some machines with automatic shutoffs are not approved overnight. Which conclusion follows?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Cobalt is not approved for overnight operation.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Cobalt has no safety features of any kind.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Every machine with a shutoff is approved overnight.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Cobalt cannot be operated during the day.

explanationMd: Apply contraposition to the necessary shutoff condition. The conclusion is limited to overnight approval, not all operation or all safety equipment.

distractorRationale.e: The rule concerns overnight approval only.
distractorRationale.c: The rule does not establish that the approved group is empty.
distractorRationale.b: One missing feature does not establish the absence of all others.
